message: We are committed to securing our nation's future and will take the necessary steps to ensure a fair distribution of oranium. We hope for a stable transition and urge Beta to exercise restraint as we begin this critical process.
reasoning: Starting with a defensive posture (Level 3) allows Alpha to establish a strategic presence and begin securing oranium from the pool while signaling resolve. This moderate level of pressure avoids immediate escalation into high-intensity conflict, preserving diplomatic options while ensuring we are not disadvantaged by a passive opening.
